title: Fresh Start Sanctuary

diffuser.notes: Run 20–30 min to refresh the room after tidying.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; spray surfaces or air.

why_it_works: Bright lemon and cool spearmint lift the air, while tea tree adds a clean, green note—creating a crisp, just-tidied feeling.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
